insight: Reportedly the first AI app in China to top 100M monthly active users after Alibaba relaunched it from a browser into an AI assistant.
name: Quark
tagline: Alibaba's AI super-app for search, writing, research and document tasks.
description: Quark is Alibaba's flagship consumer AI app, positioned as an 'AI super-box' that folds chat, deep search, deep research, AI writing, slide and image generation, document tools and cloud storage into a single interface. It identifies the intent behind a request, then plans and executes multi-step tasks. Quark runs on Alibaba's Qwen/Tongyi models and is offered across web, mobile and desktop.
edge: One free consumer app spanning chat, deep search, research, document and image tools plus cloud storage — where Western rivals are separate products.
pros: Search, writing, slides and research in one super-app
Includes cloud drive and document tools
cons: China-focused; needs Chinese language and a local account
Limited to Alibaba's own Qwen model family
Paid tiers are mainly cloud-storage upsells

references.title: Quark: only AI app in China with 100M+ monthly active users
